title: Mountain
description: THE MOUNTAIN in this poster concept (front) may be Hoth, or it may be a metaphor for the difficulties faced by the Rebel Alliance. "Gone With the Wind" is the nickname for the first campaign poster (back) for the EMPIRE STRIKES BACK by Roger Kastel, because of the romantic Rhett and Scarlett pose of Han Solo and Princess Leia. For international use the poster was changed to add Lando Calrissian, Boba Fett and other elements.
